report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is not supported by current telemetry. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with ok results. Deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so no faulty rollout is evidenced. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s, and v2.0.0 idle. No bounded cause is established; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error logs or error spans showing actual checkout failures (logs evidence was excluded)
Deployment history showing a rollout with a previous version and timing relative to errors
Metrics or traces showing non-200 responses on checkout path
Evidence of resource saturation (db pool, redis, memory) correlated with errors
